==Hero Usage==
* Hero AI has two factors governing usage of this skill:
** They will use it as a generic heal for injured teammates.
** They will use it to remove degenerative conditions (burning, bleeding, poison, and disease) on teammates under the effects of a weapon spell as soon as that condition has been applied. 
* However, on allies affected by a weapon spell, they will not use Mending Grip to remove non-lethal conditions (blindness, weakness, deep wound, crippling, dazed, cracked armor) unless that ally also needs to be healed.
